findings.evidenceJa: 二メートル近い長物
findings.governingReading: a weapon nearly two meters long
findings.explanation: The extraordinary reach that creates Assassin’s advantage is omitted.

findings.highlight: There is one meter between Saber and Assassin.
findings.evidenceJa: 間合いの差は一メートル
findings.governingReading: the difference between their effective ranges is one meter
findings.explanation: A one-meter disparity in attack range becomes the fighters’ ordinary separation.

findings.evidenceJa: 数歩分の石段を駆け上がる
findings.governingReading: dash up those few steps of stone stairs
findings.explanation: The speed and tiny distance Saber cannot overcome are weakened.

findings.highlight: if she uses her magical energy and her sword as a shield
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力と剣の威力を盾にすれば
findings.governingReading: if she presses through by relying on her mana and the force of her sword
findings.explanation: A figurative reliance on overwhelming force is converted into literally using mana and sword as a shield.

findings.highlight: if she can withstand just one blow
findings.evidenceJa: 一撃だけ受ける事を前提にすれば
findings.governingReading: if she proceeds on the premise of accepting one blow
findings.explanation: A deliberate tactical sacrifice becomes a question of whether Saber can endure the hit.

findings.evidenceJa: アサシンに踏み込み、敵を両断する
findings.governingReading: step into Assassin’s range and bisect him
findings.explanation: The counterattack’s movement and decisive bisection disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: どちらかが死んでいるかもしれない
findings.governingReading: one of them may already be dead
findings.explanation: The specific fear that either Shirou or Rin may die is generalized into both dying.

findings.highlight: in the worst casethey are already
findings.evidenceJa: 最悪既に、二人は
findings.governingReading: in the worst case, the two of them may already—
findings.explanation: Missing spacing corrupts Saber’s interrupted worst-case thought.

findings.evidenceJa: 衝突する二つの軌跡。
findings.governingReading: two trajectories collide
findings.explanation: The visual emphasis on intersecting paths of motion is flattened into object contact.

findings.evidenceJa: 鬼気迫る突進に何を思ったのか
findings.governingReading: whatever he read in her desperately fierce charge
findings.explanation: Assassin’s response to Saber’s terrifying resolve becomes unexplained arbitrariness.

findings.highlight: The swords try to push each other away.
findings.evidenceJa: 鍔迫り合いながら、互いを押しのけようとする。
findings.governingReading: locked at the guards, sword and blade strain to force one another aside
findings.explanation: The concrete guard-to-guard bind is omitted.

findings.highlight: if he used his power to strike back at the oncoming attack
findings.evidenceJa: 正面から力のみで打ち合えば
findings.governingReading: if they clashed head-on using force alone
findings.explanation: A direct contest of force becomes Assassin counterattacking Saber’s incoming blow.

findings.highlight: no matter how strong he is
findings.evidenceJa: アサシン自身の“粘り”があったところで
findings.governingReading: even with the “tenacity” Assassin himself imparts to it
findings.explanation: The blade’s reinforced resilience is reassigned to Assassin’s personal strength.

findings.evidenceJa: その迷いが、油断となった。
findings.governingReading: that hesitation became carelessness
findings.explanation: Saber’s tempted hesitation, rather than the grammatical question itself, creates the lapse.

findings.evidenceJa: 体の位置が、変わっている。
findings.governingReading: the position of her body has changed
findings.explanation: Saber’s unnoticed physical displacement is generalized to both fighters being differently placed.

findings.highlight: Saber has been forced to fight sideways.
findings.evidenceJa: 体を横にずらされ、真っ平らな足場に立たされている
findings.governingReading: her body has been shifted sideways and set upon perfectly level footing
findings.explanation: The maneuver establishing Tsubame Gaeshi’s required flat geometry becomes a vague sideways orientation.

findings.highlight: allowing no chance for defense or evasion
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に敵を絶命させる
findings.governingReading: certainly kills its target
findings.explanation: The technique’s guaranteed lethal result is omitted after its inescapability.

findings.highlight: A chill runs up her back.
findings.evidenceJa: 首筋に走る悪寒
findings.governingReading: a chill runs along the nape of her neck
findings.explanation: The bodily locus anticipating decapitation is moved away from Saber’s neck.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの力が弱まる。
findings.governingReading: the force Saber exerts weakens
findings.explanation: A graded loss of pressure under threat becomes a complete stop.

findings.highlight: Butit will be the same either way.
findings.evidenceJa: だがそのどちらも
findings.governingReading: But it will be the same either way.
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses the adversative transition.

findings.evidenceJa: 力を弱めて
findings.governingReading: reduce your force like that
findings.explanation: Assassin’s exact observation of Saber easing the blade bind becomes an overly casual instruction to relax.

findings.highlight: her eyes, trying to find some way out
findings.evidenceJa: 起死回生を狙う瞳
findings.governingReading: eyes seeking a single reversal from certain defeat
findings.explanation: The specific battle concept of a death-to-life reversal is weakened.

findings.highlight: This is no time for you to be staying here.
findings.evidenceJa: 門前払いを受けている場合ではない
findings.governingReading: this is no time to be turned away at the gate
findings.explanation: Assassin’s pointed gatekeeper wordplay disappears.

findings.highlight: She puts power into her arms.
findings.evidenceJa: 剣に力が入る。
findings.governingReading: force enters her sword
findings.explanation: The focus shifts from Saber’s weapon pressure to her arms.

findings.highlight: She puts magical energy into her sword without a plan.
findings.evidenceJa: 為す術もなく剣を合わせる
findings.governingReading: she remains helplessly locked blade to blade
findings.explanation: Physical stalemate and helplessness become poor planning.

findings.highlight: there is nothing to think about
findings.evidenceJa: 迷う隙などあるまい
findings.governingReading: there can be no room to hesitate
findings.explanation: Assassin’s call to immediate resolve becomes an assertion that thought itself is unnecessary.

findings.highlight: You are not the only one who is in a hurry.
findings.evidenceJa: 時間がないのは、おまえに限った話ではない
findings.governingReading: you are not the only one who has no time left
findings.explanation: Assassin’s impending disappearance is weakened to ordinary haste.

findings.highlight: he would like for both of them to go all-out on each other
findings.evidenceJa: 死力を尽した結果が見たい
findings.governingReading: he wishes to see the result after they exhaust the utmost strength of their lives
findings.explanation: Assassin’s desire to see the terminal result of total commitment becomes casual mutual exertion.

findings.highlight: his only compensation for being summoned in this world
findings.evidenceJa: この門を守り続けた報酬
findings.governingReading: his reward for being summoned into this age and continuing to guard this gate
findings.explanation: The service that earns Assassin’s one desired reward disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 結界を解く。
findings.governingReading: she releases the bounded field concealing her sword
findings.explanation: The Magecraft structure hiding Saber’s blade is reduced to a generic seal.

findings.evidenceJa: その姿が語っていた
findings.governingReading: her entire bearing declares
findings.explanation: Saber’s whole stance embodies total commitment, not only her gaze.

findings.evidenceJa: いざ
findings.governingReading: Come, then
findings.explanation: Assassin’s crisp invitation to begin is rendered as an incomplete English sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 腐肉の海
findings.governingReading: sea of rotten flesh
findings.explanation: Putrefaction is softened into unspecified contamination.

findings.evidenceJa: 肌にまとわりつく腐肉
findings.governingReading: the rotten flesh clinging to her skin
findings.explanation: The physically clinging flesh becomes an abstract taint.

findings.highlight: She is so tense that she’ll stop moving once she stops treating this as work.
findings.evidenceJa: 作業と思わなければ動けなくなるほど切迫していた
findings.governingReading: she is desperate enough that she cannot move unless she treats it as mere work
findings.explanation: Rin’s deliberate coping mechanism under extremity becomes general nervous tension.

findings.evidenceJa: 瘧のようだ。
findings.governingReading: it is like an ague or malarial fever
findings.explanation: The curse’s specific fever image is generalized.

findings.highlight: Her mind is too overcome with heat
findings.evidenceJa: 既に四十度を超える頭
findings.governingReading: her head already burning above forty degrees
findings.explanation: The explicit medically dangerous temperature disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: ぐあ、こ、の
findings.governingReading: Gah, damn this—
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses Rin’s broken exertion and curse into an unrelated word.

findings.evidenceJa: あと二つしかない虎の子の宝石
findings.governingReading: the last two precious reserve jewels she has
findings.explanation: The scarcity and strategic cost of Rin consuming her final two stored jewels disappear.

findings.highlight: The swallowed jewels are as good as a paper shield
findings.evidenceJa: 飲み込んだ宝石など紙にもならない
findings.governingReading: the swallowed jewels do not amount even to paper
findings.explanation: The defense is upgraded from less than paper to a paper shield.

findings.highlight: No human can ward off this curse.
findings.evidenceJa: 『奪われずにすむ』人間などありえない
findings.governingReading: no human could remain without being taken or stripped away here
findings.explanation: The curse’s inevitable seizure of the person becomes a generic inability to repel it.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分の、自分に対する強さ
findings.governingReading: one’s strength in governing oneself
findings.explanation: Rin’s hard self-command is softened into positive self-belief.

findings.evidenceJa: あつああ、もう
findings.governingReading: Hot—ahh, damn it
findings.explanation: Broken heat-stricken speech is fused into nonsense.

findings.highlight: She gets angry at herself and sets her mind straight.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の軽口が頭にきて、気合いが戻った
findings.governingReading: anger at her own flippant joke restores her fighting spirit
findings.explanation: The specific trigger and rebound in Rin’s voice are generalized.

findings.highlight: She concentrates on the sounds behind her.
findings.evidenceJa: 背後の剣戟に耳を向ける
findings.governingReading: she turns her ear toward the clash of swords behind her
findings.explanation: The exact combat sound Rin monitors is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 一気に行くから
findings.governingReading: I’m going to make the rest in one push
findings.explanation: Rin’s plan to cross the remaining distance at once becomes a claim that she will finish the whole task quickly.

findings.highlight: She can feel the mountain of meat.
findings.evidenceJa: 肉塊の山には確かな手応え
findings.governingReading: the mountain of flesh gives firm purchase beneath her hands
findings.explanation: The physical confirmation that Rin can climb it becomes generic sensation.

findings.highlight: something that should not exist in this world
findings.evidenceJa: 受肉した、この世にあってはならぬモノ
findings.governingReading: an incarnated thing that should not exist in this world
findings.explanation: The discovery that the mass has undergone the same incarnation as a Servant loses its key technical term.

findings.evidenceJa: この世にあってはならぬモノ
findings.governingReading: world—something that came out
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses the end of one clause to the next.

findings.evidenceJa: 投影
findings.governingReading: Projection, read as “Trace”
findings.explanation: The next defense again displays only the ruby reading and suppresses the written Magecraft term.

findings.evidenceJa: 背中から地面に倒れ込む
findings.governingReading: I collapse onto the ground on my back
findings.explanation: The orientation and violence of Shirou’s fall disappear.

findings.highlight: as if to test how much I can take
findings.evidenceJa: こちらの限界を試すように手を抜いている
findings.governingReading: he is deliberately holding back, testing my limit
findings.explanation: The explicit fact that Gilgamesh is reducing his effort for amusement disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: ははぁ、は
findings.governingReading: Haa, haa…
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses Shirou’s ragged breaths.

findings.evidenceJa: くあの、ヤロウ、こんなんで、どうやって
findings.governingReading: Damn that bastard—like this, how am I supposed to—
findings.explanation: Shirou’s broken question about how he can possibly win is replaced with a different question about why Archer spoke.

findings.highlight: I can’t rush at him after I block his attack.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの宝具を防ぎ、踏み込んで一撃食らわせる事もできない
findings.governingReading: I cannot both block his Noble Phantasm and step in to land a blow
findings.explanation: The two-stage defensive counterattack is reduced to rushing after a completed block.

findings.evidenceJa: フェイカー
findings.governingReading: counterfeiter, spoken as “Faker”
findings.explanation: Only the English reading survives without the source’s written counterfeit layer.

findings.evidenceJa: 投影、開始
findings.governingReading: Projection, begin; read as “Trace, on”
findings.explanation: The written operation and explicit beginning stage are replaced solely by the ruby-style English switch phrase.

findings.evidenceJa: 限られた僅かな回路
findings.governingReading: the few, limited circuits available
findings.explanation: Plural scarce pathways become one generically limited circuit.

findings.highlight: putting multiple blueprints inside a circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 複数の魔術を走らせている
findings.governingReading: running multiple Magecraft operations through a circuit
findings.explanation: Active magical operations are changed into static design plans placed inside a circuit.

findings.evidenceJa: 神経は傷つき
findings.governingReading: my nerves have been damaged
findings.explanation: Severe accumulating nerve injury is described with an odd, milder bruise metaphor.

findings.evidenceJa: 食道はポンプのように
findings.governingReading: my esophagus works like a pump
findings.explanation: The precise organ forcing pooled stomach blood outward is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 共感終了
findings.governingReading: sympathetic resonance complete
findings.explanation: A technical projection stage becomes ordinary emotional sympathy.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂からの供給は半端じゃない
findings.governingReading: the supply from Tohsaka is tremendous
findings.explanation: Rin’s extraordinary mana support becomes mere sufficiency.

findings.highlight: the circuit to channel it is about to break
findings.evidenceJa: 回路自体が、根本から倒壊しかけている
findings.governingReading: the circuits themselves are collapsing from their foundations
findings.explanation: Plural structural collapse is reduced to one conduit breaking.

findings.evidenceJa: この体は破裂する
findings.governingReading: this body will burst
findings.explanation: The specific catastrophic bodily rupture caused by mass projection becomes generic death.

findings.evidenceJa: 工程完了。全投影、待機
findings.governingReading: process complete; all projections on standby
findings.explanation: A completed preparation and standby state becomes unrelated rollout and ammunition language.

findings.evidenceJa: 外に出ようとする剣
findings.governingReading: the swords trying to emerge outside
findings.explanation: Intentional pressure toward manifestation is generalized as overflow.

findings.highlight: if the circuit cannot be controlled
findings.evidenceJa: 回路が焼き切れ制御できなくなれば
findings.governingReading: if the circuits burn out and can no longer be controlled
findings.explanation: The physical cause of control loss is omitted.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou will be pierced from within
findings.evidenceJa: 針千本と化す
findings.governingReading: Emiya Shirou will become a thousand-needle pincushion from blades thrusting outward
findings.explanation: The grotesque culmination of Shirou’s body becoming a mass of outward blades is weakened.

findings.highlight: What sort of hero would I be
findings.evidenceJa: 何が英霊か
findings.governingReading: what kind of Heroic Spirit would I be
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s formal class of being becomes generic heroism.

findings.evidenceJa: 千の財宝
findings.governingReading: a thousand treasures
findings.explanation: The explicit thousand is inflated into an unspecified multiple of thousands.

findings.evidenceJa: もっともいかに精巧であろうと
findings.governingReading: However, no matter how finely made they are, I will not allow
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses Gilgamesh’s transition to the pronoun.

findings.evidenceJa: 王の財宝
findings.governingReading: the Noble Phantasm name Gate of Babylon, written “the King’s Treasury”
findings.explanation: A named Noble Phantasm is rendered as an ordinary plural possessive phrase.

findings.highlight: Freeze out, sword bullet full open…!
findings.evidenceJa: 停止解凍、全投影連続層写
findings.governingReading: release suspension; continuous layered manifestation of all projections
findings.explanation: The emergency command to release and layer every prepared projection becomes incoherent weapon jargon.

findings.evidenceJa: 衝撃が内と外を震わせる
findings.governingReading: the impact shakes both his interior and the outside world
findings.explanation: The simultaneous shock through Shirou’s body and the external battlefield becomes generic environmental shaking.

findings.highlight: I am no match for him
findings.evidenceJa: 初めから火力が違いすぎる
findings.governingReading: their firepower was far too different from the outset
findings.explanation: The exact reason sequential projections cannot meet a simultaneous volley is generalized to inferiority.

findings.highlight: you are holding well with your fragile works
findings.evidenceJa: 硝子細工にしてはよく持つ
findings.governingReading: you are holding together well for a piece of glasswork
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s comparison of Shirou’s breaking body to glasswork is reassigned to the projected weapons.

findings.evidenceJa: 八つ裂きだぞ
findings.governingReading: you will be torn into eight pieces
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s vivid dismemberment threat becomes generic death.

findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯だけでも取り外す
findings.governingReading: detach at least the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: The plan to remove or separate the vessel is changed into recovering possession of it.

findings.highlight: The magical energy I emit and the heat from the crashing Noble Phantasms
findings.evidenceJa: 自ら放出する魔力と、その寸前で衝突し、弾け合う宝具の熱
findings.governingReading: the heat of Noble Phantasms colliding and bursting against his emitted mana immediately before his fingertips
findings.explanation: The defensive collision between emitted mana and incoming weapons is blurred.

findings.highlight: Such hypocrisy to try to save him. As expected from a mongrel!
findings.evidenceJa: その偽善、まさに雑種の具現
findings.governingReading: that hypocrisy is the very embodiment of a mongrel
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s claim that Shirou physically embodies mongrel hypocrisy becomes a routine insult.

findings.highlight: My circuit is completely burning off.
findings.evidenceJa: 回路が、完全に焼き切れる
findings.governingReading: the circuits are burning out completely
findings.explanation: The network-wide failure is again reduced to one circuit.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の剣製とアイツの剣製
findings.governingReading: my sword-forging system and his sword-forging system
findings.explanation: The comparison between two forms of sword production becomes the narrower act of projection.

findings.evidenceJa: 石柱ともとれるソレ
findings.governingReading: a bizarre sword that might be mistaken for a stone pillar
findings.explanation: The weapon’s defining stone-pillar appearance disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 嘲笑う声が響く
findings.governingReading: a jeering voice rings out
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s spoken taunt carried by the sword’s roar becomes laughter.

findings.highlight: I eliminate the three remaining blueprints in my circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 回路に残る三つの魔術を全て破棄し
findings.governingReading: I discard all three Magecraft operations remaining in my circuits
findings.explanation: Live prepared spells are again reduced to design documents.

findings.evidenceJa: 全速でヤツの剣を解読する
findings.governingReading: analyze his sword at full speed
findings.explanation: The desperate maximum-speed reallocation of Shirou’s processing disappears.

findings.highlight: I was able to read every sword.
findings.evidenceJa: それが剣であるのならどんな物だって読みとれた
findings.governingReading: until now, he could read anything at all so long as it was a sword
findings.explanation: The conditional breadth of Shirou’s prior ability becomes a finite claim about swords encountered.

findings.evidenceJa: 風が、断層を作り上げる。
findings.governingReading: the wind creates a fault or shearing discontinuity
findings.explanation: The spatially cutting fault formed by the wind becomes abstract chaos.

findings.highlight: I just release the remaining magical energy within me
findings.evidenceJa: 残った魔力を叩きつけた
findings.governingReading: he slams all remaining mana against the attack
findings.explanation: A desperate forceful collision becomes neutral emission.
